value.rationale: A finite exact-invariance step could be mistaken for exact sampling efficiency. The combined theorem gives a complete Gaussian benchmark for the source two- and three-stage schemes, including a unique positive isotropic exactness resonance, an impossibility for anisotropic SPD curvature under one common h, and a quantified 7/3 asymptotic physical-time variance penalty despite exact invariant marginals. This distinguishes invariant distribution fidelity from autocorrelation/time-average accuracy in an actively studied Langevin Monte Carlo algorithm; it is not merely a renaming or general convergence-order consequence.
